We’re renaming our Max plans: 

Max 5x → Max
Max 20x → Ultra

Max is still $100/month, and Ultra is still $200. If you’re a subscriber, there’s nothing you need to do.

Weekly limits remain unchanged. View our plans here:  https://t.co/niRpyGF5Me

tweetHighlights.originalTitle: Bullish on Andy Yen and Proton.
tweetHighlights.originalBody:
Bullish on Andy Yen and Proton. He gets it.

The culture war, or rather the loss of identity some engineers feel as AI redefines our jobs is difficult; I sympathize. Also understand that he runs a business and might has limited patience when we now had two years to process, learn, change and grow.
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
我非常看好严谨的安迪·严和Proton公司。他很懂行。

人工智能重新定义我们的工作，导致一些工程师感到身份认同的丧失，这种文化冲突或这种丧失感令人难以接受；我对此深表同情。我也理解他经营的是企业，而我们花了两年时间来消化、学习、改变和成长，所以他的耐心可能有限。

If you a millenial who loved The Next Generation and miss Patrick Stewart, I highly recommend watching Picard season 3. 

I saw it years ago and it's the proper ending this crew deserves. Very grateful to @TerryMatalas and folks for making it.

You don't need to watch season 1 and 2, just go straight to season 3.
